SEARCH
Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.numa

Interface NumaAwareAllocator

public interface NumaAwareAllocator
Interface for NUMA-aware object allocation in HFT systems. Provides mechanisms to allocate objects on specific NUMA nodes to minimize cross-node memory access latency.
